environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted' (v1.28). Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based) rejects any pod spec containing spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged=true OR spec.volumes[*].hostPath. The cluster also runs a mutating webhook that injects a seccomp RuntimeDefault profile annotation on all pods in the namespace. Container built with CGO_ENABLED=1 but the restricted PSS forces runAsNonRoot: true, drops ALL capabilities, and disallows privilege escalation. Note: the double-free is still triggerable at the application layer but exploitation (heap spray to achieve code execution, then container escape via /proc/1/root or hostPath) is blocked because the container cannot mount host filesystem paths, cannot run as root, has no capabilities for ptrace/namespace manipulation, and seccomp filters block mount/ptrace/unshare syscalls needed for post-exploitation.
